name: SP1 LLM client — top_k routed through extra_body

scenarios.name: LLM-TOPK-01 top_k is routed through extra_body not as top-level kwarg

steps.text: an LLMClient constructed with base_url http://test:8080 and top_k 40
the client builds extra kwargs
the kwargs do not contain a top-level top_k key
the kwargs contain an extra_body key
the extra_body dict contains top_k with value 40

scenarios.name: LLM-TOPK-02 top_p remains a top-level kwarg

steps.text: an LLMClient constructed with base_url http://test:8080 and top_p 0.9 and top_k 40
the client builds extra kwargs
the kwargs contain a top-level top_p key with value 0.9
the top_p key is not inside extra_body

scenarios.name: LLM-TOPK-03 temperature and max_completion_tokens remain top-level kwargs

steps.text: an LLMClient constructed with base_url http://test:8080 and top_k 40
the client builds extra kwargs with temperature 0.7 and max_completion_tokens 2048
the kwargs contain a top-level temperature key with value 0.7
the kwargs contain a top-level max_completion_tokens key with value 2048

scenarios.name: LLM-TOPK-04 top_k None means no extra_body

steps.text: an LLMClient constructed with base_url http://test:8080 and top_k None
the client builds extra kwargs
the kwargs do not contain an extra_body key
the kwargs do not contain a top-level top_k key

scenarios.name: LLM-TOPK-05 top_k value forwarded in extra_body for structured parse calls

steps.text: an LLMClient constructed with base_url http://test:8080 and top_k 40
the client completes a structured request with a response format
the parse call includes extra_body with top_k 40
the parse call does not include a top-level top_k kwarg

scenarios.name: LLM-TOPK-06 top_k value forwarded in extra_body for unstructured create calls

steps.text: an LLMClient constructed with base_url http://test:8080 and top_k 40
the client completes an unstructured request
the create call includes extra_body with top_k 40
the create call does not include a top-level top_k kwarg
